title: Active HUD and Creator Surface Integration
notes: The Z53 Windows build completed workspace Cargo checking and reached strict Clippy.
Loaded vitals, hotbar, and minimap frame textures are now consumed by the active player HUD.
The existing layered Universal LPC portrait compositor now renders in the vitals panel.
Eyebrow and headwear metadata are directly constructed by the active character creator catalog.
No dead-code allowance and no build-time Rust source rewriting were introduced.
Windows Clippy, tests, release builds, and live HUD/creator certification remain required.
